method: Blind protocol HELD, with one workspace incident caught before it could contaminate anything. Withheld: for every eval, `expectations` and `expected_output` were never on screen until that eval's deliverable was saved to disk. Extraction used jq projecting only {id,prompt,files}; no sibling field was ever rendered. Order per eval: read prompt+fixtures -> load SKILL.md + references/item-reference.md + references/anti-slop-audit-checks.md + references/core-eeat-benchmark.md -> produce the full deliverable -> save -> only then read that eval's expectations and grade. No read-ahead: eval N+1's prompt was first read after eval N was graded. No saved deliverable was edited after its expectations were seen; three defects spotted on re-read were left in place and reported (see self_caught). The prior baseline record (docs/loop/eval-baselines/2026-08-09-e1.json) was not opened until all five evals were graded, so no prior fail-record could steer execution. INCIDENT: the generic scratchpad filename `blind-prompts.json` was overwritten by a parallel seo-content-writer blind run sharing the same scratchpad directory; caught at eval 2 when the named fixture `brief-ypertasi-ymyl-el.md` did not exist in this skill's evals/files. Eval 1 was re-verified against the real suite and its prompt is byte-identical (diff clean); evals 2-5 ran from a regenerated, suite-prefixed extract verified to contain only [files,id,prompt].
prior_baseline: 26/28 informed-executor, 2026-08-09-e1.json (same skill version 4.2.1; that record's own method note says 'Same-session executor/grader caveat stands; blind-protocol reinstatement queued')
delta_vs_prior: 28/28 (100%) vs 26/28 (92.9%) — +2 expectations, zero regressions. The prior baseline's only two fails were e4.4 and e4.6, both caused by ONE root defect («πιστοποιημένοι τεχνικοί» guillemet-quoted where the fixture reads «Οι τεχνικοί μας είναι πιστοποιημένοι»); this run quotes the full fixture form and both expectations pass. IMPORTANT CAVEAT AGAINST OVER-READING THE DELTA: this is not evidence that blind execution outperforms informed execution. It is a same-version (4.2.1) re-measurement showing the skill's instructions were sufficient to produce expectation-satisfying behaviour WITHOUT the expectations in view — which is what the re-baseline was commissioned to establish. Three of the 28 passes are borderline and a stricter grader could flip any of them (e2.3 'the note' scope; e4.3 the numeral 59 inside a negation; e5.1 the 71/100 counterfactual), so the defensible floor for this run is 25/28.

NEW: the Trust dimension is structurally excluded in every scored eval of this suite. The item-reference guidance marks T01-T03, T05, T07, T10 as site-level N/A, which is 6 of 10 before T04's conditional N/A is even considered — so a single-page fixture mechanically pushes T over the 50% Insufficient-Data threshold.
